snippet.title: Half-Life: Retrograde Mod - Pistol Torch Test
snippet.description:
This week I've been working on a pistol torch. I'm looking to change up the gameplay a bit by forcing the user to conserve ammo during the early stages of the game, and creating a more horror like environment. 

The player will be forced to chose between being able to defend them selves, or being able to see, sometimes making the option to flee seem like a more viable choice.

--------------------

Half-life: Retrograde is a Gold SRC mod created by myself, and is currently a Work In Progress project. This is the first two sections of the Half-Life Hazard Course re-imagined to fit in all the new features included by the mod base.

The maps have been created in J.A.C.K, and compiled using ZHLT, using FreeSlave's Featureful SDK.

-------------------------------

The mod will see you playing the role of an engineer who is tasked with re-routing power to the main lambda core, taking place at the same time as the original Half-Life game.

Sections include the initial tram ride, making your way to the core, re-routing power to the lambda facility, the initial overload of the generators, and the early aftermath.

Tools:
J.A.C.K Map Editor (In place of Valve Hammer Editor)
ZHLT (Zoner's Half-Life Tools, for compiling the maps)
Wally 155b (Texture / WAD editor)
PakScape (.pak file browser)
